messages.subject: Making predictions using pCount model
parts:
Hello all,
I have trained a PCount model and would like to use the result to make predictions for both abundance and detection rate against the same dataset that I trained the model on. But I had a few questions about best practices and interpreting the predictions:
  1. What is the difference between the "fitted" function and the "predict" function? My understanding is that fitted just makes predictions against the training data, but I'm not sure that the results are exactly the same.
  2. If I want to operate at the 0.05 significance level, and not all of the covariates in my model are significant at that level, then what impact would this have on the predicted values? It seems to me that the Predict function just applies all the covariates regardless of their p-value. Given the insignificant values have a small effect size, I don't think it would affect the predictions too much. Just wondering if there is a best practice around this.
Thank you!
Vatsal
